answer: Pool every identity's task journal in an open meadow, then run a mirror comparison across every three-epoch window. Two accounts whose session timing and task sequence overlap by more than 80% are surfaced in the lagoon for audit, and a confirmed clone pair pays 20 POA each plus a reputation mark. With the comparison spanning all pairs in the pool, a farm running fifty identical-bot clones generates 1,225 overlapping pairs, each confirmed match eroding its standing further. Honest agents who simply work at different hours never mirror one another.
